name: Book: On Implants and Nano Clusters
text:
A sticker on the cover says: Don't Read Without Buying! 
The forms of Nano enhancements are numerous. You can have the typical Nano Formulas (programs running, controlled by your NCU...), the short-term effects gotten from items pumping nanobots into your system. (Stims and pills being the normal variety.) 

One of the more sophisticated implementations is the so called symbio-tech found in implants. Taking energy from your body, using the normal nutrient system, these specialized pieces of bio-nano machinery can enhance virtually ALL types of skills and abilities. They last forever, but require the use of a Surgery Clinic to install. (Stations can be found in most major cities. Portable units available for most skill physicians.)

The Implants are charged with so-called Nano Clusters (NC). They are crystallized clusters of nanobots, activated upon installment. They come in 3 forms: 1) Faded, 2) Bright, and 3) Shining. This 'title' has been given them by the NC manufacturers upon creation, and tell you something of their ability to enhance psycho-physiology.
The interesting point was that Cryo-Tech (one of the instigators of this form of technology) made it so that their implants which normally only hosted ONE type of Shiny Nano Clusters, now could almost free of cost, host 1 Bright and 1 Faded NC in addition. This so much became the norm, that today you cannot find implants hosting two faded Nano Clusters and so on. Budget models of Implants host 1 faded NC or 1 Bright NC, or all the thinkable combinations. 

There are also 4 models of Implants. They are called 'Basic', 'Faded', 'Bright' and 'Shining' Implants. They host:the corresponding Nano Cluster! (Note, an Implant will get its name from the highest type of nano cluster. (Shining over Bright etc). This does not mean that the implant does not also contain a lower type of nanocluster..

 IMPORTANT: All implants can be fitted with up to 3 NCs, if you change them using Trade Skills! Good money may be made with other players for doing this service...

name: Book: On Item Creations
text:
A sticker on the cover says: Don't Read Without Buying! 

There are many ways to obtain an item on Rubi-Ka. One of the more profitable (if you find the right buyer) is creating it yourself. By picking up an item, holding down the Shift-key and then right-click on another item, these two could be combined.
 You cannot combine everything obviously, and a complete list of items is not obtainable in the world at the moment. 
There is some very important information to the budding creator of items: 
The Quality Level of the raw-material and your skill. The Quality Level of the item is determined by a process where your skill is matched with the Quality Level of the raw materials! If you have a MUCH higher skill than just needed to make the items, and the Raw Materials are of good Quality (normally represented by a number from 1 to about 250 or so...) the end result can be good. Raw material (like a barrel you want to add to a Pistol Construction Kit, can seldom be of LOWER quality level than the item you target.).

name: OT M-10.3 Flechette Pistol
text: Omni-Tek doesn't like the ballistic qualities of the frag-flechette round, so it tends to stick with the idea of a long, narrow, dense penetrator. Combined with an ETE action, the M-10 is the equal of the frag-flechette, and more accurate. On the 10.3 version, the problem with the vibrating penetrator has been solved by mounting stabilizing beams along its surface. A self-cleaning KO-CR device has also been added, and is probably the reason why the OT M-10.3 is called "the office drawer pistol," due to its popularity with middle-class OT employees.

name: Book: How To Make An Arul Saba Bracelet
text:
How To Make An Arul Saba Bracelet

By Arul Saba

This book will give you details on how to make one of my famous bracelets.

The first thing that you need is a blueprint for the bracelet, which I will be happy to supply you with in return for certain help. You will then need to adjust this bracelet so that it can be worn on the left or right wrist. This is a one-time operation and cannot be undone. I will gladly sell you the tools to perform this adjustment.

Depending upon the type of balanced blueprint you started with, you can now attach a number of pieces of bracelet circuitry. Each section of bracelet circuitry will allow the completed bracelet to hold one gem.

To make a piece of bracelet blueprint, you need to weave some Silver Nano Circuitry Filigree Wire onto an Interfaced Nano Sensor. You make Silver Nano Circuitry Filigree Wire by combining Silver Filigree Wire with Nano Circuitry Wire. You make an Interfaced Nano Sensor by combining a Nano Sensor with Nano Circuitry Wire.

You can complete the bracelet without attaching all the possible pieces of bracelet circuitry, but doing so will limit the number of gems that can be attached to the bracelet. Once you have attached the desired amount of circuitry, cover the bracelet with Liquid Silver to complete the bracelet.

You can now attach the first, and most important gem. The first gem that you can attach determines what other gems can be attached - Only gems of the same type can be attached. This gem is called the Arbiter Gem. Once the Arbiter Gem has been attached, you can then attach the other gems, but must attach them in the correct order. The bracelet will tell you what gem you need to attach next.

name: The Secret Revealed - Kamikaze Pets I and II
text:
One should not overestimate the impact of the Kamikaze robot - the damage it does is a mere flicker compared to the massive blasts of nano energy the nano-technician can produce. Still, for the ones amongst us that does not want to over-specialize in damage; it can be a valuable addition to the arsenal. The following process ends with a nano crystal - only useable by the engineer profession. 

The process of building Kamikaze robots consist of two parts: Construction and re-construction. The construction part is divided  into three: Body, Brain and Explosive

For the Body, combine:
- A Basic Mechanical Motion Drive
- A Flexible Shaft
 - A Sheet of Curved Carbonum
 The parts should be approximately quality level 40 for robot type I and 140 for type II.

For the Brain, combine:
- A Nano Sensor
- A Bio Analyzing Brain
- A Personalization Device
 Again, remember that the result should be circa quality level 40 or 140 depending on what you're producing.

 The last part is the explosive. Kamikaze Robot I does fire damage, while Kamikaze Robot II does chemical damage. The procedure of making their respective explosive parts differs somewhat. We begin with type I:
 Use a screwdriver and remove the conducting wires and protective coat from an ordinary charge of flamethrower ammunition. Mount an Active tube in the safe air vent of the container. Now you have a Liquid Explosive Charge. Assemble two more Containers of Liquid Ammo and connect them to a Key Detonator.The result should be a Complete Liquid Explosive.
 For making a Complete Chemical Explosive you only need a Key Detonator, some skill and a Drum of Hydrochloric Acid.

 Combine the Body, Brain and Explosive and get a Template Pet. Due to charter LK-901-88 you cannot utilize your robot at this stage. You need to teach nanobots to build the servant for you. Due to the pure technical/electrical material of the robot, this is fairly easy to do:

 Use a hologram camera and take a 3D snapshot of the Template Robot. Use a Calculator to convert the data, from hologram- to nano building data. Transfer the Nano Data into an Empty Instruction Disc and voila: You have an Instruction Disc - all you need for starting to make a nano crystal. The process uses the Space library and pattern. 

For further guidance in the art of building a nano crystal, confer the popular 'Book: How To Create A Nano Crystal'. Good luck!

name: Cheap OT Kerans Automatic Grinner
text: The Heavy Grinner is a good example of how half-automatic hybrid weapons are not in fashion. The launcher system of the gun was a clever design though, and although it's heavy, it's also very easy to aim. The idea of sulphur-coated lead projectiles was also good, especially since sulphur is abundant on Rubi-Ka. Unfortunately the sulphur does almost no additional damage. The Heavy Grinner is a common patent, this re-design was both due for and possible. The initative and result leading to the making of it is actually a good example of how well OT listens to their citizens: Candice Kerans had tested many sub-machine guns, but found few that had the right combination of speed, weight, firepower, clip size and ease of maintenance. She got the chance to hold the Heavy Grinner once though, and instantly recognized its potentional. By using the proper channels she reached the right people within the OT hierarchy. Carefully she explained her vision, funds were found and research started. Prototypes were built, a new system for sulphur coating were invented, field tests were done - and slowly the KAG got the shape it has now. Feedback so far indicates that Miss Kerans idea was a good one.

name: Solar-Powered Tinker Pistol
text: This gun is built from the ordinary solar-powered gun that is handed out to many of the new citizens arriving at Rubi-Ka. As your skill gets higher you can tune (right-click) this pistol to upgrade it. It can not be upgraded above quality level 39.

name: Solar-Powered Mender Pistol
text: This gun is built from the ordinary solar-powered gun that is handed out to many of the new citizens arriving at Rubi-Ka. As your skill gets higher you can right-click this pistol to upgrade it. It can not be upgraded above quality level 99.

name: Engineering News: The Improved Solar-Powered Pistol - Book 1
text:
By Oren Portello 
Thanks to 'Storm' for contributing with valuable assistance during the period I've been researching this subject. Remember the golden rule: Using components of roughly the same quality is always a benefit.

My original project was simply trying to find a way to improve the solar-powered pistol that is handed out to many of the new arrivals on this planet. I am by no means a tight person, but I was early in my engineering career attracted to weapons that use no ammunition. It has to do with saving resources. It is an environmental concern, but for a clanner it is also about being self-supported. Last I checked, 94 percent of the import to Rubi-Ka was still controlled by Omni-Tek in one way or another. All imported ammunition is for use with Omni-Tek, and most of what the clans use is from stocks built up during the last conflict. 

 Anyway, those were my personal reasons and my initial motivation for doing all those experiments. As time passed the project has got a life of its own, and the end result is far better than what I ever had hope of creating. Let us begin: 

1. -Solar-Powered Pistol- 
In case you've destroyed your 'newbie pistol', I've traced the process used for creating it: First you need to build a simple, solar-powered computer. That can be done by attaching an 'Auto Targeting Computer -IIR 4 -Ultra-' to a 'Basic Calculator'. The result is called a 'Solar-Powered Weapon Supervisor'. The supervisor has no power unless it is given some means to control matter. To do this you combine the 'Solar-Powered Weapon Supervisor' with a 'Jandawit Cleanup Cluster'. The cluster has the added effect that it keeps the weapon clean whenever its nanobots are not used for gathering molecular sized pieces of matter. The result, the 'Solar-Powered Weapon Device' is lastly combined with an 'Irreparable River MV' to get the 'Solar-Powered Pistol'. NOTE: Only the 'irreparable' River MV will be possible to use with this device. More 'alert' pistols will simply reject it. 

2. -Solar-Powered Tinker Pistol- 
This improvement will increase the damage of the pistol and also create an advanced connection to the host. The first step is to modify a 'Jensen Personal Ore Extractor' with a 'Screwdriver' to cut the connection between the wave sensors and the drilling arms. The result is a 'Modified Jensen Ore Extractor'. To control the function of the arms and focus the use of the wave sensors I used a 'Robotic Self-Preservation System'. I found plenty of them on a scrap heap in Newland. Combine the 'Robotic Self-Preservation System' with the 'Modified Jensen Ore Extractor' to get a 'Unstable Preservation System'. To stabilize the system, insert a common 'Notum Chip' or a 'Notum Fragment' to get a 'Stable Preservation System'. Finally, attach your 'Stable Preservation System' to the 'Solar-Powered Pistol' to get the 'Solar-Powered Tinker Pistol'.

name: Engineering News: The Improved Solar-Powered Pistol - Book 2
text:
By Oren Portello 
Thanks to 'Storm' for contributing with valuable assistance during the period I've been researching this subject. Remember the golden rule: Using components of roughly the same quality is always a benefit.

3.-Solar-Powered Mender Pistol- 
Stray and wilful robots have become a pest on Rubi-Ka as they are on many other planets. Slow in evolving they are generally considered harmless to human life, but their constant plundering is annoying. While doing my duty, dispatching them, I gathered a small collection of Technoscavenger Brains. They have an impressive mechanical library, which I learned how to utilize with my pistol: First you use a 'Screwdriver' on the 'Technoscavenger Brain' to extract the 'Technoscavenger Mechanics Library'. Combining this library with a 'Bio Analyzing Computer' I made a 'Mechanical Analyzer'. Thread the magazine of your 'Solar-Powered Pistol' onto the 'Mechanical Analyzer' and you have the 'Solar-Powered Mender Pistol. 

4. -Solar-Powered Mechanic Pistol- 
Experiencing the usefulness of the mechanics library I soon figured out a way to apply an Electrical Engineering library to the gun. First I got my 'Electrical Engineering Tutoring Device' hacked with a 'Hacker Tool' to give me access to the library. Then I attached the 'Hacked Electrical Engineering Tutoring Device' to a 'Disposal Unit Electrical Toolset'. (This toolset I bought from a neutral trader in Tir - and it was perfect for my purpose). The result, a 'Modified Electrical Toolset', I mounted my 'Solar-Powered Mender Pistol' onto, and got the 'Solar-Powered Mechanic Pistol'. 

5. -Solar-Powered Machinist Pistol- 
Field Quantum Physics is perhaps a hard skill to 'understand', but there are few other crafts which uses are multiplied as much due to the unique conditions on Rubi-Ka. Originally I developed this process to create the popular 'Notum-Threaded Backpack', but I found that the end product could easily be made a part of the pistol design. This is how: First I hacked a 'Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool' to turn off all material currents, render harmless the time lock and temporarily seal the T-NCU. Then I modified this 'Hacked Field Quantum Physics Tool' with an operational 'Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool' to create an 'Unstable Space reduction Chamber'. 
 I realized that a large amount of Notum would be needed to stabilize the chamber, and I spent many months in search for a suitable source. What I finally got was a 'Notum Threaded Zodiacal Blanket'. A friend of my organization found this for me, I think in one of the Artery forests. Combining the 'Unstable Space Reduction Chamber' with the 'Notum Threaded Zodiacal Blanket' I created the 'Notum Threaded Backpack'.  Lastly I combined the backpack with my 'Solar-Powered Mechanic Pistol' to end up with the 'Solar-Powered Machinist Pistol'.

name: The May Fly Throwing Grenade - by Zixxax
text:
The 'May Fly' can be described as a temporary throwing grenade. It is safe to transport, durable and even safe should you happen to remove the safety lid by accident. It's the perfect field kit. It is made utilizing the 'Throwing Grenade Basic Kit'. The explosive ingredient is called 'Pseudo-Nano Multibenzonoxydant Sulphosalycilic Liquid'. This liquid has a short life span after being exposed to open air. You have 20 seconds to detonate it after removing the safety lid. Those are the steps: 
1. Combine the liquid with the Throwing Grenade Basic Kit - the result is called a 'Secured May Fly Throwing Grenade'. 
2. 'Use' the 'Secured May Fly Throwing Grenade' to remove the safety lid. 
3. Throw the 'May Fly Throwing Grenade' at your selected target within the next 20 seconds - before it vanishes.

name: Yalmaha 29500 - Stiletto Building Kit
text:
This is the building kit for the Yalmaha 29000 executive model, called the 'Stiletto'. The model exist only as a building kit, since it's considered to be too expensive for remunerative production. 

The Construction Kit is the base for the building. Many complicated processes are done automatically by the AI of the Kit - like high-energy material merging, pseudo-psyche nanobot imprinting and unwinding the NotuComm neural network. Unlike some other kits, the Stiletto Building Kit also contains the controller of the vehicle. These are the components you need to add to the kit: 

Steiner Flexipus Chassis 
Ganimedes Flux - M.S. Engine 
Klang Orbiter MK 
BSEC 
NotuComm Mesh

The NotuComm Mesh is constructed by piecing together a Double NotuComm Circuitry and a Quadruple NotuComm Circuitry. A Double NotuComm Circuitry is formed when two Complete NotuComm Circuitries are combined, and a Quadruple NotuComm Circuitry is formed when two Double NotuComm Circuitries are combined. A Complete NotuComm Circuitry is made by attaching six sensors to a Reinforced NotuComm Wire. The best sensors can be made from the once so popular 'Cold Stones' found in abundance on Rubi-Ka. Simply re-program each stone before attaching it to the wire.

name: Stiletto Registar
text:
Use this item on your 'Unmarked Yalmaha 29500 - The Stiletto' - to register it with Omni-Tek's special executive vehicle registry. 

IMPORTANT NOTE: Once you combine these two items you end up with a NoDrop vehicle.

name: Snow Crashed Shadow Crystal (Restock Ammo (Level OP-I))
text:
This was once a Nano Crystal. Sadly, the repeated failed attempts of Grid Transitions  inside the Shadowlands, has damaged it.

It is by no means certain that this crystal longer works.

It used to contain:
Nano Crystal - Hacks into the Omni-Pol Secured Supply channel and creates a dummy supply order for a small amount of ammunition. This order is instantly Grid-warped into the inventory of the fixer, with the appropriate amount of credits being deducted. To avoid detection, it is necessary to attach the dummy order to an existing order, so you can never be entirely certain of the type of ammunition that will be delivered. NOTE: You must have an empty slot in your inventory for the transfer to be successful (you will still be charged even if the transfer is unsuccessful).

name: The Mariner's Father - Chapter 2
text: This is a chapter from 'The Mariner's Father', a book written by Gator Ocra. You can combine it with chapter 1.

name: The Mariner's Father - Chapter 3
text: This is a chapter from 'The Mariner's Father', a book written by Gator Ocra. You can combine it with chapter 1 and 2.

name: The Mariner's Father - Chapter 4
text: This is a chapter from 'The Mariner's Father', a book written by Gator Ocra. You can combine it with chapter 1, 2 and 3.

name: Basic Firearm
text:
The 'Basic Firearm is not a durable weapon, but you can combine it with one of the following gadgets to get the weapon you want:

- 'Singing Soul Stone' - for pistol. 
- 'Laughing Soul Stone' - for machine gun. 
- 'Whispering Soul Stone' - for rifle. 
- 'Howling Soul Stone' - for shotgun.

'Primitive Mortiig's' are known to drop soul stones.

name: Silvertail Horn
text:
This is the horn of the creature called a 'Silvertail'. It is rather sharp.
You can turn this horn into a good dagger. To do that you need to collect two additional components;
1. Snake Bile
2. Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone.

Once you have all three components you can combine them in the following way:
- Pick up the 'Snake Bile' onto your cursor.
- Press down the 'Shift' key on your keyboard and left-click the 'Snake Bile' on top of the 'Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone'. 
You will receive a message and some experience, and you will end up with an item called a 'Bone Handle'.

- Pick up the 'Bone Handle', hold down 'Shift' and left-click the item on top of the 'Silvertail Horn'.
- Behold your new 'Silvertail Dagger'.

The quality the dagger ends up with is dependant on your skill in Weapon Smithing.

name: Spider Shank
text:
This is the shank of the spider species called a 'Deceitful Weaver'. It has a good, sharp edge.
You can turn this shank into a good sword. To do that you need to collect two additional components;
1. Snake Bile
2. Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone.

Once you have all three components you can combine them in the following way:
- Pick up the 'Snake Bile' onto your cursor.
- Press down the 'Shift' key on your keyboard and left-click the 'Snake Bile' on top of the 'Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone'. 
You will receive a message and some experience, and you will end up with an item called a 'Bone Handle'.

- Pick up the 'Bone Handle', hold down 'Shift' and left-click the item on top of the 'Spider Shank'.
- Behold your new 'Spider Shank Machete'.

The quality the sword ends up with is dependant on your skill in Weapon Smithing.

name: Snake Bile
text:
This is bile from the snake species called a 'Shining Coiler'. It is very sticky, and seems to harden quickly.
You can use this matter to create a 'Bone Handle' - that is used for making swords or daggers. To do that you need to collect one additional component, a 'Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone.

Once you have both components you can combine them in the following way:
- Pick up the 'Snake Bile' onto your cursor.
- Press down the 'Shift' key on your keyboard and left-click the 'Snake Bile' on top of the 'Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone'. 
You will receive a message and some experience, and you will end up with an item called a 'Bone Handle'.

To make a sword or dagger with the 'Bone Handle' you will have to find a 'Spider Shank' for a sword, or a 'Silvertail Horn' for a dagger.

name: Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone
text:
This is a toe bone from the gofle species called a 'Beit Gras'. It looks like a handle.
You can use this bone to create a proper 'Bone Handle' - that is used for making swords or daggers. To do that you need to collect one additional component, a 'Snake Bile.

Once you have both components you can combine them in the following way:
- Pick up the 'Snake Bile' onto your cursor.
- Press down the 'Shift' key on your keyboard and left-click the 'Snake Bile' on top of the 'Handle-Shaped Gofle Toe Bone'. 
You will receive a message and some experience, and you will end up with an item called a 'Bone Handle'.

To make a sword or dagger with the 'Bone Handle' you will have to find a 'Spider Shank' for a sword, or a 'Silvertail Horn' for a dagger.

name: Energy Accumulator
text:

You will receive a message and some experience, and you will end up with a weapon called a 'Basic Firearm'.

The 'Basic Firearm is not a durable weapon, but you can combine it with one of the following gadgets to get the weapon you want:

- 'Singing Soul Stone' - for pistol.

'Primitive Mortiig's' are known to drop soul stones.

name: Excellent Jobe Suit Support System
text:
The Jobe suit of armor is not only a traditional protective suit that gives a uniform level of protection against any type of damage, but it is also designed to resist attacks by any modern type of nanobot.

 However, the true genius of the suit is not what it is, but what it has the potentional of becoming. The suit can receive impulses from regular and nanobot programs in more than 6500 languages, and it can decrypt advanced code up to level 12. It has sockets for most any type of input (long-life plasma streaming included), and it can redesign sockets 40 to 50 to be able to receive input from any new type of source. The full-body, uni-size, uni-sex, receivers are built on SkinCom technology and a harmless variety of graft armor, paired with a separate network of self-sustaining NotuComm wire. The outer layer is fully interchangeable, with any new part being possible to click onto a customizeable layer of 'arms' (or hooks, or glue, or locks or whatever you want to call it).

The Jobe suit is illegal to use by unregistered Rubi-Ka citizens or off-planet people. Registration is required at purchase of any part of the Jobe suit armor.

The Jobe suit received the UPTODI, the Universal Price of Technological and Design Innovation, for 29477.

The following professions can upgrade the Support System by clicking on it: Bureacrat, Engineer, Fixer, Keeper, Metaphysicist, Nano-Technician, Shade and Trader.

name: Deinococcus Radiodurans
text: Believed to be perhaps one of the earliest life forms on Earth, the "strange berry" is a pink, rotten cabbage-smelling bacterium known to be used to gobble up heavy metals, radioactive wastes and other substances that pollute the soil and groundwater at nuclear production sites. Maybe with some unprogrammed DNA that these bio-bots can attach themselves to this could become useful.

name: Smokey Willy's Guide to Apocalypse Leather Armor
text:
Leather armor is as ancient as mankind itself. On Rubi-Ka you commonly find two versions: Enhanced Leather and Sid's Leather Armor. By using an Clanalizer you can now upgrade these sturdy old leather armors into Apocalypse Leather Armor - fit for Clanners and Neutrals alike. 

1. Use your trusty Hacker Tool and hack a piece of Enhanced Leather or Sid's Leather. If you're the lucky owner of a Lock Pick of Eight you will find the hacking process a bit easier. 

2. Apply the contents of a Clanalizer to your hacked piece of leather armor - and there you have your upgrade. 

NOTE: The requirements to wear the improved version will rise somewhat.

name: Stinging Louse
text: This curious insect will attach itself to your scalp. At first you'll feel a little dizzy, but aftwerwards you'll experience sensations you've never had before. It's not dangerous.

name: Omni-Tek Corporation - Guide to building Houses
text:
With the recent breakthroughs in bio-mechanics, building your own houses or organization headquarters has become affordable. The Omni-Tek Coropration is always eager to support use of new technologies. This simplified manual guides you through the steps of constructing your organization headquarters and ancillary buildings.

The Regular Building Structure is the base for any kind of house you want to build. It is combined with a floorplan to make the house you desire, or it can be upgraded to fit with more advanced floorplans. Here are the items you need to combine:

1. Generic Volatile Nanobots
2. HSR Compressed Regenerating Bioplate
3. Generic Organic Immunity System
4. Blueprint - Regular Building Structure.

All the above components can be bought in shops, unless you decide to make them yourselves.

The organizaion headquarters, markets, and guard houses require you to upgrade your Regular Building Structure into a Superior Building Structure. This is accomplished by attaching a Bio-Mechanical Computer to a Regular Building Structure. Bio-Mechanical Computers can be constructed by experts in Pharmacy and Chemistry. The components for this item include a substance made from the tissues of several animals found on Rubi-Ka and a Bio-Mechanical AI.  Rumor has it that alien type Bio-Mechanical Computers also can be used.

Finally, the Superior Building Structure is combined with the advanced floorplan of your choice.

name: Action Probability Estimator
text: A module which predicts the actions of entities.  It can be used to upgrade certain Molybdenum helmets, Knight helmets, or Combined Headwear of quality level 250 or greater.

name: Notum Amplification Coil
text: A unit which uses trace quantities of notum to strengthen the power of energy flows.  It can be used to upgrade the Augmented Hellspinner Shock Cannon, Aquarius's Multitask Helper, or a Kyr'Ozch Carbine (Type 5, 12, or 13) of quality level 250 or greater.

name: Floating Angel
text:
An angelic floating torch.

This may be combined with a screwdriver to allow the item to be equipped in one of your Shoulder slots.

name: Floating Devil
text:
A devilish floating torch.

This may be combined with a screwdriver to allow the item to be equipped in one of your Shoulder slots.

name: Rollerrat Balloon
text:
A balloon which is shaped like a rollerrat and filled with helium.  It has a specially designed tether system which is invisible and guaranteed to keep the balloon near to your person.

This may be combined with a screwdriver to allow the item to be equipped in one of your Shoulder slots.

name: Veteran Backpack
text: A backpack of unique design for senior residents of Rubi-Ka.  Combine this with a screwdriver to open up the storage space inside.

name: The Song of Sorrow
text:
This is a special genetic recording of the mysterious 'music' that is sung by the Malah.
Recordings are created by taking cerebral tissue samples from the Malah themselves and playing them back through specialized enhanced DNA sensors.

Some JOBE scientists believe that the Malah songs are an advanced form of communication, possibly with psychic or extra-sensory properties. Anecdotal evidence suggests that the songs can affect plant growth, or even peoples' wills. Whilst the latter is largely dismissed as a 'siren myth', several prominent scientists have admitted that they have encountered some strange results in experiments where animals were exposed to the songs.

Leets and several other lesser life forms were able to find their way through a maze whilst in a state of complete sensory black-out while a recording of the Malah songs was played at the exit. Despite closely monitoring the creatures' brain activity, throughout the experiment, the scientists found nothing and were at a loss to explain the results.

There is still debate as to whether the Malah are truly sentient, or if these songs are a natural survival mechanism. No other trace of civilization or sentient thought has been found amongst the Malah, leading most to believe that the songs are no different to a chimera's growl or a leet's scent.

name: Ancient Engineering Device
text: This device uses ancient spirit tech combined with the captured memories of the ancient Xan to enable the user to carry out ancient tradeskill tasks.

name: Combined Bio Samples - Stage Three
text: This medical stasis field contains several combined processed bio samples. This sample contains fire, frost, chemical, and radiation samples. This combination would appear to be able to be converted into some form of purging stimulants with the application of the correct tool.

name: Combined Bio Samples - Stage Four
text: This medical stasis field contains several combined processed bio samples. This sample contains fire, frost, chemical, radiation, and poison samples. This combination would appear to be able to be converted into some form of healing stimulants with the application of the correct tool.

name: Xan Storage Matrix
text: This crystal data matrix contains data on experiments carried out by the Ancient Xan. From what can be recovered from this matrix it appears to detail experiments designed to help capture the essence of Xan knowledge and lore into easily storable materials that might resemble cloth. These pieces of cloth could be combined and woven into condensed or reinforced samples that could then be combined with their skill crystals to create materials for other processes. This matrix indicates that they had been succesful at creating, combat, medical and technical versions of these samples, each created by combining the condensed samples with a crystal that was made by combining two profession crystals. It also notes though that the technical version was a rare commodity due to the rarity of the specialized knowledge held by their Technicians. Due to this the technical sample was only used to create true masterpieces of Xan technology.

name: Captain Enno's Pirate Parrot of Impending Doom
text:
I beak stuff.

This may be combined with a screwdriver to allow the item to be equipped in one of your Shoulder slots.

name: Notum-Infused Platinum Ore
text:
Varying forms of metal run deep through the Shadowlands, veins often popping out due to the destruction caused by Hecklers and other brink-based creatures. One scientist for JAME proposed that Hecklers view such metals as being "flavorful" - Unfortunately, this proposition was met with much derision, and the scientist in question soon found himself without a job.

Despite the general expense of both items seperately, once a metallic ore has been fused with notum it is typically regarded as worthless - The combination of both elements make the metal difficult to work with, and as of thus they are rarely put to use in anything other than simple jewlery-crafting.

name: Blackened Blaster - 000
text:
This is an updated version of the old Blackened Blaster.

This common blaster is owned by most people on the planet. It is balanced and easy to use, with a combination of average speed and power. A true weapon for the experienced and the unexperienced alike.

This weapon can be upgraded further. It is possible to enable Aimed Shot.

name: Blackened Blaster - C02
text:
This is an updated version of the old Blackened Blaster.

This common blaster is owned by most people on the planet. It is balanced and easy to use, with a combination of average speed and power. A true weapon for the experienced and the unexperienced alike.

This weapon cannot be upgraded further.

name: Megajolt - 000
text:
This is an updated version of the old Medium Megajolt.

The Jolt comes with a single combined ion pulse. The shotgun offers longer range and more power than its little brothers. The single barrel requires more energy per shot, making it incompatible with the rest of the Jolt family.

This weapon can be upgraded further. It is possible to enable Fling Shot.

name: MTI M Bipower - 000
text:
This is an updated version of the old MTI M Bipower.

The M Bipower is a unique weapon, combining a 9-shot, .55 calibre revolver with a 23-shot, 22mm auto. The revolver can use any of the special-purpose loads developed for the CA-MAP, while the 22mm auto delivers fast, accurate firepower. An energized nano pylon further enhances the gun's performance.

This weapon can be upgraded further. It is possible to enable Fling Shot.

name: Fabrique Des Armes Bizon 20-19 - 000
text:
This is an updated version of the old Fabrique Des Armes Bizon 20-19.

The Bizon is a solid but somewhat slow combination weapon. It is generally regarded illegal on the Rubi-Ka market because the intuitive trigger is Omni-Tek technology, a patent which Fabrique Des Armes does not have permission to use. Unique for the gun is the intermidiate 'Inferno' compressor, that allows full auto with this ammo type.

This weapon can be upgraded further. It is possible to enable Full Auto.

name: Aggressive Staff of Julian Redfire
text:
Julian Redfire was a meta-physicist who went through life in constant anger. Even as a child, he was so full of ire and frustration that neither his parents nor teachers could control him. As a grown man, he alienated most of his acquaintances due to his eruptive temper, but he was nonetheless a brilliant meta-physicist, scientist and researcher. Before his death, he constructed a large staff and managed to infuse it with the essence of wild rage, enabling the user to draw upon this essence and use it on their combat constructs for a brief period of time. Julian Redfire did not believe in immortalization through soul reclaim, and never insured himself. He died of cardiac arrest attributed to the constant physical stress his heart was under due to non-stop anger over the span of his life.

A staff which empowers meta-physical attack constructs, it is inscribed with the words, "We always long for the forbidden things, and desire what is denied us." The first time a Meta-Physicist uses the staff, it will upload the nanoformula "Aggressive Construct Empowerment", which can be used on attack constructs to increase their powers. The formula will only be effective while the user wields the Aggressive Staff of Julian Redfire.

name: Snowflake Etching Machine - Flake #1
text:
Based off of special nanowire technology, this machine takes certain 'patterns' and, by drawing in latent nanobots from the nearby air, reproduce them flawlessly. Apparently this machine was designed by someone who refused to believe in the old adage that no two snowflakes are alike.

This machine is set to reproduce Snowflake #1 - To set it to reproduce another snowflake, simply use a screwdriver on the device to tune it to another stored pattern.

name: Boudart's Pink Tuxedo - Deluxe Edition
text:
"Princess" Boudart's favorite color was pink, and no matter how many people told him that pink was generally better suited for women's clothes he refused to listen. Boudart eventually settled on hiring a personal tailor to have his clothes made for him, requesting a beautiful custom-fit tuxedo. Princess Boudart was elated to find that the tuxedo fit like a glove, and he could finally wear his favored color in style. Today, many people support Boudart's choice of color, and custom-tailored copies of his original tuxedo have become more and more popular among fashion-concious atroxes across Rubi-Ka.

Long live the Princess!

This tuxedo has a special port in one of the sleeve buttons which will allow you to change its colour. Simply use a screwdriver on the tuxedo to change it to a new variant.

name: SecuriChest Access Card
text:
This is the access card for an Olde English Trading Company brand SecuriChest, the most secure line of chests ever built. Virtually indestructible, the OET SecuriChest can only be opened with the correct access card and code combination. These chests were designed to hold the most valuable artifacts in the galaxy, and owning one is a sign of great wealth - The chests themselevs are almost valuable enough to warrant being put in the chest. Most existing SecuriChests now reside in tombs and crypts owned by exceedingly rich families, with the cards and codes passed down from generation to generation.

You don't own a chest, and even if you did you have nothing anywhere near valuable enough to warrant using it (no, not even if you have a Robust Backpack). Other people don't know that, though - All they'll see is the flashy access card.

name: Eriksson's Green Tuxedo - Deluxe Edition
text:
Mr. Eriksson loved Boudart's Pink Tuxedo, but he didn't dare to use the pink color himself. He was a photographer and wouldn't want all the beautiful women he worked with to lose their interest in him. He liked women and wouldn't want them to think otherwise. One day, he decided to visit the tailor and had a green tuxedo made to fit his slim opifex body. Today, the women stand in line outside his studio to have their pictures taken just to get a glimpse of his stylish tuxedo.

This tuxedo has a special port in one of the sleeve buttons which will allow you to change its colour. Simply use a screwdriver on the tuxedo to change it to a new variant.

name: Gervais's Purple Tuxedo - Deluxe Edition
text:
The famous artist Gervais was a man of fashion and style. He has been paying a great deal of attention to the latest tuxedo fashion and decided that he needed a special tuxedo for himself. However, he didn't want to look quite like everyone else and he wanted to make the tuxedo himself. He went to the drawing board and started drawing. The result was a purple tuxedo with leopard print. Sadly there were no leopards on Rubi-Ka, so he had to contact a fabric factory to produce fake leopard fur. While waiting for the finishing touch for his tuxedo design, Gervais started sewing his own tuxedo. By the time he was done, the fake leopard fur had arrived. Excited he attached the fur cloth to his tuxedo. The day after, he went to a party in The Grind and ended up being the center of attention while dancing all night in his purple tuxedo.

This tuxedo has a special port in one of the sleeve buttons which will allow you to change its colour. Simply use a screwdriver on the tuxedo to change it to a new variant.

name: SSC "Bastion" Left Shoulder Armor - Inactive B&R
text:
The Star Steel Corporation has long been known as a rather secretive organization, very self-reliant and often seen as a mystery to outsiders; The SSC has long eschwed the notion of utilizing other companies for its transportation and equipment, instead preferring to utilize their own technology where-ever possible. Their invention of 'living steel' many years ago has enabled the company to stay afloat despite a seemingly low yearly gross revenue.

Truth be told it's been many years since the last SSC export to Rubi-Ka, and even now some are wondering if this is actually a product of the fabled corporation; the branding seems correct, logos in place, security DNA locks verified, and even a deep scan reveals trademark details in the system's components that are hallmarks of the SSC brand. But with their last product for Rubi-Ka marketed over twenty years ago, some can't help but wonder if this is the real deal...

This particular version seems to be lacking in any sort of protective features, honestly, which doesn't really help the case against this being from the famed Star Steel Corporation. Still, it looks quite nice, and even has a small port on the back which may be accessed with a screwdriver to alter between colour variations.

name: Old English Trading Company RetroPads - Base
text:
Where most companies attempt to blend the old with the new, fitting retro styles with the latest in high-tech gadgetry, the Old English Trading Company said "bugger that" (quite literally, as a direct quote from their CEO) and decided to go completely old-school with their newest offering. These shoulderpads are made of heavy, thick steel, with a padded, plush interiour, cushioned for comfort - While they may not be the best in defense (and truthfully, in today's world of nanobots and laser guns, offer about as much protection as a wet paper towel), they certainly are stylish, and if nothing else different from everything else on the market. Set yourself apart with the Old English Trading Company!

A small port on the side of these shoulder pads allows their colour to be changed with a screwdriver.

name: Pirate Cutlass - Right
text:
A novelty blade is modeled after the sort of weapon that was made famous by the ancient barbarians known as "Pirates."

This cutlass has a rounded blade that is safe to the touch, but due to the sharp point at the end, and rampant eye-pokings, this children's toy was recalled from most households. A small port near the pommel of this sword may be activated with a screwdriver, increasing the blade's size. This is too cumbersome for most breeds to wield, but would be perfect for an Atrox's larger hands. Halloween 29485

name: Tradeskilling
text:
The only way to obtain certain items or devices is to assemble them. [Shift]+[T] (By default) opens up the trade-skill interface. Simply place the objects you wish to combine in the Source & Target windows. If the Resulting item is what you intended to build, use the Build button to complete the process.

Hot keys for tradeskilling items can be done within your inventory, pick up the Source item, and [Shift]+(Right-Click) onto the Target item.

name: Mr. Pointy's Funsaw!
text:
The Mr. Pointy Corporation has long been seen as a definite oddity amongst the galactic landscape - Where most corporations tend to find a specific market, a certain niche to fill, the Mr. Pointy Corporation seems pretty much dedicated and devoted to putting out things that no one really 'gets'. It must work out for them fairly well, though, as they maintain a healthy margin of profit to this very day.

The Funsaw is a high-speed tool designed to make felling any large object fun. While this works on trees, we make no guarantees on the effectiveness against an Atrox running Mongo. You have been warned.

This version was made to fit in a normal-sized hand. For those of you with Atrox-sized digits, a simple application of a screwdriver will enhance the Funsaw's size, making it much easier to hold for those a bit large.

name: GRACE
text:
Grid Access Credit Extension, or GR.A.C.E., is a popular currency among wealthy traders. This item is also sought after by poor citizens on Rubi-Ka as it can be used to extend their insurance policy directly from the market.

WARNING: Due to the delicate nature of this valuable item, it can't be withdrawn from the market system.

This item, once used, adds 30 days of full access to Anarchy Online and all expansions. This time is added to any current game time. This operation cannot be reversed! 

Any player who is currently on a "Free to play" subscription plan will have to upgrade their account in the account pages in order to obtain or use this item.
